description: Change a texture set the account owns: its look (controls: seed, scale, colours, contrast, bumpiness, roughness {min, max}, metalness, size, tileWorldSize, height, applied to the set's own recipe; `scale` multiplies its pattern, so 2 is twice as fine as now) or a whole new `recipe` (read the current one with r3_texture_read, change it, pass it here). The set itself never changes: the change is saved as a new version under the same name (the user's lists show the latest), with new maps, and every project and release that uses an older version's maps keeps them. Give `name` only to make a separate copy under that name instead. The same recipe as the latest version saves nothing. The answer names the user's projects still on an older version; put the new set on a material with r3_texture_apply when the user wants it. An invalid change is refused with the path of the problem. Counts as one render toward your hourly texture budget.

controls.description: Changes to its recipe: {seed, scale, colours, contrast, bumpiness, roughness: {min, max}, metalness, size, tileWorldSize, height}.

name.description: Only to make a separate COPY under this name. Default: a new version of the same set, same name.

recipe.description: Or a whole new recipe (format "r3-texture-recipe", version 1).

setId.description: The set to change (r3_texture_create / r3_texture_read answer it). The account's own.

name: r3_texture_update

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Change a texture set: make a new version of it
